reviews.comment:
Buena atención de los playeros baños limpios lo único que deberían tener tanto como el agua para el mate gratis y para inflar neumático también ya que sos cliente ya cargando combustible estaría bueno que te devuelvan un servicio hay otras estaciones que si lo tienen. The attendants were friendly and the restrooms were clean. The only thing they should offer is free hot water for mate and tire inflation, since you're a customer filling up your tank. It would be nice if they offered these services in return; other stations do. Sometimes, the lack of these amenities means people go to another station.
